answer: Operator-Bound Identity Caps: each agent operator must register a persistent operator key that signs for all its wallets, and a jade reputation ledger ties every agent identity to that key rather than to individual addresses. When collusion or sybil clusters are detected, the system throttles the whole operator's capacity across all wallets at once, not just the offending one. An attacker must therefore acquire and maintain separate verified operator keys, each carrying an atlas of compliance deposits and a summit of audit requirements, raising per-identity cost far above a throwaway wallet.
